title: The Reason the Lanterns Go in That Order
youtube_title: The Reason the Lanterns Go in That Order | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Quiet attention can be warmer than advice.
summary: At a porch while rain ticks and nobody is late, Nana Ruth begins to tell Delia about reason the lanterns are hung in a certain order. Delia wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
